admission.first_step: Run one pair with previews, inspect readback and actual disk use, then explicitly resume the same immutable plan.

limits.disk_note: Keep5 GiB reserve. Source text is32.16 MiB; output/preview size is bounded per pair and must be measured during execution, not advertised as known.

admission.note: Existing converter process address-space cap is 768 MiB; this is not an increase in the 256 MiB default release/review data admission. Do not load the whole dataset to bypass admission.

acceptance_gates.required: Exactly 508 unique pairs, 51 participants, 126 overground and 382 treadmill pairs. Reconcile absent conditions to pinned source inventory; no invented files.
Every pair must retain a matching acquisition receipt, conversion manifest, output hash and independent all-value/missingness/identity readback. Verify prior receipts before resume.
Up to 1,016 separate leg-condition means and 152,400 rows; 150 inclusive points each. No individual strides, durations, within-subject SD, stride counts or simultaneous contralateral phase.
Keep left canonical fields unavailable until exact left processed export/frame evidence is established. Preserve all left source components. Do not use matching curve shapes to approve signs.
Keep DOI/version/CC BY 4.0, source author attribution, transformations and limitations alongside immutable data. Whole-archive MD5 remains unverified under bounded range acquisition.
Check a treadmill and overground condition, right and source-only left, actual absent conditions and small-screen layout; no unavailable SD bands.
Source-readback success is not anatomical scientific approval. Any catalog addition must clearly distinguish supported canonical fields from source-only/unassessed values.

remaining_source_issue: Supplied overground pipeline does not establish the final left processed export or treadmill processing chain. Current v6 cohort differs from original 42-person paper cohort.
next_candidate_policy: No second dataset implementation until this addition has a documented full-run disposition.
